policy: Raw, curated, or live-resolved OpenPage avatar records must carry explicit catalog identity, a unique catalog contract address, or an OpenPage ID covered by data/openpage_catalog_bindings.json before they can enter a collection inventory. Shared indexes and platform-default models are retained as unbound discovery leads. Animation-only GLBs are preserved as evidence but are not avatar-model candidates. Live requests create partial discovery candidates only.

records.note: Shared OpenPage supported-avatar index. Any links found here remain unbound discovery leads until a curator supplies a collection-specific OpenPage ID, metadata ID, contract, or catalogId.

sharedDrive.note: Drive file-page URLs are preserved as source evidence rather than binary inventory URLs. They require a dedicated Drive download resolver before structural probing.

examples.note: The workflow resolves each ID against /m/mml/{id}, preserves source evidence, and discovers referenced VRM or model GLB URLs.
